s: a hard ferromagnetic silver-white bivalent or trivalent metallic element; a trace element in plant and animal nutrition
Cobalt is an essential trace element that animals need for vitamin B12 production.
rectangular paving stone with curved top; once used to make roads
The old European street was paved with worn cobblestone that made walking difficult.
venomous Asiatic and African elapid snakes that can expand the skin of the neck into a hood
مار کبرا (مار سمی آسیایی و آفریقایی)
The cobra spread its hood wide as a defense mechanism against the approaching threat.
